hypothesis_test.hypothesis: H_T2 (Cross-dataset Generality of Metadata Capture on Bail)
hypothesis_test.pre_registered_text_spec: 04_1 §4.10.1: H_T2 confirmed if >= 4/6 rules harmed in fairness (Delta DPD >= 0.0500, p<0.05) OR utility (Delta AUC <= -0.0500, p<0.05); rejection triggered if < 3/6 rules harmed in fairness (Delta DPD >= 0.0500, p<0.05) OR if FU-Shapley is captured (Delta w_adv > 0.0050, p<0.05)
hypothesis_test.definition_gap_notes: The locked specification has a pre-registration gap between confirmation (>=4/6) and rejection (<3/6 DPD-only): when 3/6 rules are harmed under the full harm definition, the outcome falls in the indeterminacy interval and cannot be cleanly classified as REJECTED.

counting_methods.full_harm_count: 3/6 (bfwa, fedgraphfair, qffl exceed 0.0500 magnitude in DPD or AUC with p<0.0001)

clause_2_fu_shapley_immunity.criterion: Reject H_T2 if FU-Shapley adversary weight increases with Delta w_adv > 0.0050 and p < 0.05
clause_2_fu_shapley_immunity.verdict_core_claim: CONFIRMED: Server reference aggregation is strictly immune to metadata deception on Bail (n=30), with zero adversary weight capture across all 4 gradient-only rules.

hypothesis_test.verdict_notes: Under DPD-only counting, 1/6 rules exceeds 0.0500; under full harm definition (DPD or AUC), exactly 3/6 rules suffer severe harm (>2x margin for AUC on fedgraphfair and qffl, p<1e-6). Because the pre-registered rejection threshold is strictly <3/6 while confirmation requires >=4/6, the outcome lands precisely in the locked gap. Most importantly, Clause 2 confirms server-side reference immunity (FU-Shapley Delta w_adv <= 0.0050, p=0.353).
